invariants: wallet connection is always an explicit user action using eth_requestAccounts
account and chain identifiers are normalized and validated before signing
configured Exchange chain ID is required before transaction signing can become available
chain mismatch is explicit and fails closed until corrected
account change, chain change and disconnect invalidate previously reviewed transaction drafts
signing requests are bound to the reviewed intent and current wallet-session generation
no implicit signing request is produced by connect, navigation or data refresh
rejected connection/signature paths remain recoverable without mutating protocol state
follow_on: V14.11 reliability, accessibility and responsive hardening
